verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for a government digital service with online filing and search portals, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions cookie settings, analytics opt-out, or telemetry controls. The evidence covers only trade mark and patent filing, search, fees and identity requirements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
